newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan seeks over 100,000 tonnes of Syrian barley.
newsitem.headline: Jordan seeks over 100,000 tonnes of Syrian barley.

text.p: Jordan is currently negotiating a deal with Syria to buy at least 100,000 tonnes of black barley, traders said on Thursday.
They said a delegation headed by Jordan's Minister of Supply Munir Sobar left for Damascus on Wednesday to conclude the deal.
Jordan's last deal with Syria was in December when it bought 100,000 tonnes at $138 per tonne FOT.
The kingdom imported at least 300,000 tonnes of barley last year from Syria, which covers a major portion of its annual consumption of around 500,000 tonnes.
